Audra Riley

Democratic candidate for Court of Criminal Appeals, Place 4, Texas

Judge, Dallas County Criminal District Court No. 3

Audra Riley is a Democrat who has been judge of Dallas County Criminal District Court No. 3 since January 2021. She is a former Dallas County felony prosecutor and criminal defense attorney. She ran in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary, and the Texas Secretary of State certified her for the November 3, 2026 general election ballot as the Democratic nominee for Court of Criminal Appeals, Place 4, against Republican incumbent Kevin Patrick Yeary.

Where Riley stands

Due process and constitutional protections
Emphasizes due process and says constitutional protections should be applied consistently.
Wrongful convictions and appellate review
Says the court must balance public safety with fairness and carefully review claims of wrongful convictions or procedural errors.
Sentencing
Emphasizes equitable sentencing.

Background

  • Judge, Dallas County Criminal District Court No. 3, 2021–present (elected 2020; re-elected unopposed 2024; current term ends 2028)
  • Former felony prosecutor, Dallas County District Attorney's Office
  • Former criminal defense attorney in solo private practice
  • Licensed by the State Bar of Texas, 2006
  • J.D., Thurgood Marshall School of Law, Texas Southern University, 2006
  • B.A./Bachelor's in Criminal Justice, Sam Houston State University
